competency_questions: Which RAG approach has the highest mean reported performance score, and what is that mean with how many evaluations?
If two approaches tie on mean score, which one is ranked first and why?
Does the ranking change if we restrict to evaluations on a single shared dataset versus pooling all datasets?
definition: The retrieval-augmented generation approach with the highest mean of its reported RAG performance scores across papers in the corpus, ties broken by higher number of reported evaluations.

measure.filter: evaluation reports a numeric RAG performance score for the approach

needs: explicit RAG approach names per paper
numeric performance scores per approach per evaluation

scope.datasets: all datasets used in those papers for RAG evaluation
scope.papers: all papers in the corpus that evaluate at least one retrieval-augmented generation approach with a numeric performance score

title: Top-scoring RAG approach by mean reported performance
